_: Labeled cases for .claude/jev/calibrate.py. expect=flag means the rule should score at or above its threshold; expect=pass means below. expect=straddles (or expect_by_rule for one rule) sits on the line: reported, never failed. Baselines are measured medians of 3 runs against the rules as committed; re-record when a rule or the pinned model changes. Each case carries exactly the state its rules declare, matching what review.py sends. baseline is what the case measured when last recorded; --record overwrites it. Cases marked withdrawn_only run only with --include-withdrawn; their failures are printed but never counted.

cases.name: verb_rules_pass_real
cases.why: Withdrawn rule: the same class after Declare* was split into Intern/Resolve/Create/Assert/Build by what each actually does. verb_disagreement scores the IMPROVED code 0.66 and flags it - the rule is inverted, and the pair proves it. This is the fixture the suite never had: without a realistic counterpart to the defect case, a per-case suite validates that a rule fires, never that it discriminates.
